_licence.acknowledgement: Scores engraved for the Mutopia Project by Allen Garvin and placed in the public domain by the typesetter.
_licence.note: The licence and the engraver were read from each piece's own .rdf by tools/build-piano.mjs and never copied by hand. One file, one licence, one engraver.

title: Three menuets from the Notebook for Anna Magdalena Bach, engraved by Allen Garvin

fields.readable: false when the reader could follow no bar of the piece. The piece keeps its licence and its credits and drills nothing.
fields.bars: the bars the reader could follow, numbered as written in the source.
fields.bars[].notes[].d: the diatonic index of the note, C4 being 28, so a staff position is one subtraction.
fields.bars[].notes[].acc: the accidental to print, or null. Settled here so that no drawing code has to.
fields.read.refused: what was dropped, and how often, per piece.

petzold-anh114.title: Menuet in G, BWV Anh. 114
petzold-anh114.rcm_note: RCM 2022 lists this menuet under Petzold. Mutopia files it under BachJS, which is where the nineteenth century put it.

petzold-anh115.title: Menuet in G minor, BWV Anh. 115
petzold-anh115.rcm_note: The companion of Anh. 114 and attributed to the same organist.

bach-anh116.title: Menuet, BWV Anh. 116
bach-anh116.rcm_note: The research placed it near Level 3 and could not verify that number, so no level is claimed here.
